==About me==

I am an educator and writer. My "day job" includes teaching philosophy at a classical school, and I moonlight as a philosophy instructor, writer, copy editor, real estate investor, public speaker, consultant, and life coach. 

I have about a thousand edits on Wikipedia, and have been a user there for 14 years, an editor for 8. 

I started Robert Jordan's ''Wheel of Time ''when I was 14 and have been slowly finishing it ever since.
